generator.horror_town.fog_harbor.info: A grey, drowned coast under a sky that never clears.
commands.horror_town.fog.wrong_world: There is no fog cycle here: this is not a Fog Harbor world
townsfolk.horror_town.line.0.0: The fog is thicker than yesterday. Yesterday's was thicker than the day before.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.0.1: Fresh fish. Pulled up from the bottom. A long way down.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.0.2: Get indoors before dark, stranger. Don't ask why.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.0.3: Don't look at Her in the temple for too long.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.0.4: The sea went out a long way today... like it's drawing breath.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.0.5: We're all born by the water here. We all go back to it.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.1.0: Can you hear it? Someone's singing down there.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.1.1: My neck? It's nothing. The sea wind split it.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.1.2: The Tide Mother remembers everyone who comes ashore.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.1.3: Don't touch my hands. They're wet. They're always wet.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.1.4: Don't look out of the window at night. I mean... don't let it see you.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.1.5: Soon, soon. The tide's coming in soon.
townsfolk.horror_town.line.2.3: ...(it only stares at you, without blinking)
townsfolk.horror_town.line.2.5: ...why are you... still on the shore?
townsfolk.horror_town.keeper.0: The incense must burn, the candles must not go out. If they do, She comes out to look.
townsfolk.horror_town.keeper.1: What does the stranger want? The Tide Mother gives anything. For something in return.
townsfolk.horror_town.keeper.2: Don't raise your voice in the hall. She is sleeping.
message.horror_town.watched: Something out at sea is looking at you.
message.horror_town.tide.start: A horn sounds far out at sea. The tide is coming in.
